name: Almonds and Milk Chicken Curry
ingredients: 500g chicken (bone-in, skinless), cut into medium pieces
1 cup whole raw almonds, soaked overnight and peeled
1/4 cup warm water for grinding almonds
instructions: 1. Grind the soaked and peeled almonds with 1/4 cup warm water to a smooth, thick paste. Set aside.
2. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds, cardamom pods, and cinnamon stick; sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
3. Add chopped onion and sauté until golden brown, 6-8 minutes. Stir in ginger-garlic paste and green chilies; cook for 2 minutes until raw smell disappears.
4. Add turmeric, coriander, and garam masala; stir for 1 minute. Add chicken pieces and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is browned on all sides, about 8 minutes.
5. Pour in the milk and bring to a gentle simmer. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until chicken is tender.
6. Add the almond paste and mix well. Simmer uncovered for 10-15 minutes, stirring frequently, until gravy thickens to desired consistency. Adjust salt.
7. Garnish with fresh cilantro. Serve hot with naan or steamed basmati rice.
description: A velvety, aromatic symphony of toasted almonds and warm spices, gently embracing tender chicken in a luscious, milk-based gravy.
